exposure: first trimester serum uric acid levels
cohort: The study included 106 low-risk pregnant women.
finding: First-trimester serum uric acid levels higher than 3.4 mg/dl significantly predicted Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), showing 74.70% sensitivity and 82.61% specificity.
gest_age: Exposure measured in 1st trimester; outcome diagnosed between 24-28 and 28-32 weeks of gestation.
